# Code map

Read this before searching. If a file, export, type, endpoint or table is not listed here, it does not exist —
say so instead of guessing. Line counts tell you what a file costs to read. Tests are omitted.

## API operations (contracts/openapi.yaml)

- `GET /api/health` — getHealth
- `GET /api/presence` — getPresence: Home or away, whether it is dark, and the phone-report token (only when asked from the Mac itself).
- `GET /api/rooms` — listRooms
- `GET /api/devices` — listDevices
- `POST /api/devices/discover` — discoverDevices: Look for Govee lights (local network, then Govee cloud if an API key is set) and add new ones without a room.
- `GET /api/devices/{deviceId}` — getDevice
- `PUT /api/devices/{deviceId}` — updateDevice: Rename a device or move it to a room (roomId null = no room).
- `POST /api/devices/{deviceId}/commands` — commandDevice: Change a light. The TV and phone are read-only (422 read_only_device).
- `POST /api/devices/{deviceId}/report` — reportDeviceState: The phone's automation app reports what changed (home, charging, asleep). Only push devices accept reports (else 422 not_reportable).
- `POST /api/devices/{deviceId}/pairing` — startPairing: Ask the TV to show a pairing code. Only android-tv devices pair (else 422 not_pairable).
- `POST /api/devices/{deviceId}/pairing/confirm` — confirmPairing: Finish pairing with the code the TV shows. A wrong code fails with 422 pairing_failed.
- `GET /api/scenes` — listScenes
- `POST /api/scenes/{sceneId}/activate` — activateScene
- `GET /api/automations` — listAutomations
- `GET /api/automations/runs` — listAutomationRuns
- `GET /api/automations/{automationId}` — getAutomation
- `PUT /api/automations/{automationId}/enabled` — setAutomationEnabled
- `POST /api/automations/{automationId}/simulate` — simulateAutomation: Dry-run the automation as if its trigger fired now (and held for forMinutes). Changes nothing; explains every decision.
